acceptance: A proved initial vacuum-response theorem with explicit tails and correctly limited operator/weight conclusions is meaningful. Record any unclosed graph/domain or summability claim as limited. No full homogeneous H0+D+R gap or continuum result is admitted without its separate missing premises.

definitions.acceptance_topology: Exact forms/operators on the specified product-reference space; explicit norm/energy/response-graph convergence and finite-volume errors if proved. Spatial vector locality, bounded local-operator locality and a convergent volume-weight interaction decomposition are different claims.
definitions.actual_diagonal: phi_b=-(tau/3) sum_(21 actual omitted faces at b)W_f; P_b is the product reference vacuum on the complete four-site star, Q_b=I-P_b; D_b=Q_b phi_b Q_b. D_Lambda=sum_(b+G subset Lambda)D_b. Retain all declared star supports even when a face has smaller actual support.
definitions.boundary_complete_response: For finite cuboids Lambda containing Y, define G_Lambda=H0_Lambda+D_Lambda, u_Lambda=(G_Lambda|Q_Lambda)^-1(v_Y tensor Omega_(Lambda\Y)), embedded by the exterior vacuum. Construct a limiting u and justify its inverse equation and domains if possible, keeping every star that can act; no local interior inverse substitution.
definitions.collars: Y^(n)={x in nonnegative Z^3: min_(y in Y)||x-y||_infinity<=n}. Specify support of each coefficient, Hilbert and H0^(1/2) tails, and operator-graph tails for this response if valid. Give explicit constants/functions uniform in containing finite cuboids, and finite-volume comparison when a collar lies inside Lambda. No unnamed O(.) remainder suffices.
definitions.controls: Effective rejecting tests for omitted boundary action, wrong inverse/sign or bare truncation, source-sector identity error, tau=0, collar counts, geometric and polynomial tail formulas and volume-weight overclaim. Freeze full source/input closure and reproduce exact outputs in ordinary and optimized Python.
definitions.coupling: Real homogeneous tau with |tau|<=5/1664, including tau=0; an enlarged justified interval may be stated separately. This is the initial O1 diagonal only, not every later centered diagonal.
definitions.fixed_controls: Use the R1 normalized character source at origin, free positive z-link physical tail(0,0,0), v=Tr(g_e)Omega. Include tau=0 and both coupling signs. For source-sector distinction fix an exterior free-character excitation at coarse site e_x (physical free z-link tail(4,0,0)) in a containing cuboid. Compare the global vacuum rank-two source with A_Y tensor I on that actual vector. A finite-dimensional surrogate alone is insufficient.
definitions.physical_scales: a>0,E_star>0,alpha/E_star>0,hbar>0 fixed. delta=alpha/8 is the energy unit. h,D,G,source,generator and tau below are dimensionless; multiply Hamiltonians by delta and use physical t/hbar. No Q2 complementary gap, magnetic positivity or fitted coefficient may be transferred.
definitions.reference_space: H0 is the nonnegative tensor sum of the actual h_x on the product-reference incomplete tensor product H_Omega, with vacuum Omega and Q=I-|Omega><Omega|. Distinguish the form domain, operator domain and the domain of a constructed local response. Do not infer D(G)=D(H0) globally from a form comparison alone.
definitions.source: For any fixed finite nonempty complete-factor support Y and bounded self-adjoint R_Y, set v_Y=Q_Y R_Y Omega_Y, r=||v_Y||, v=v_Y tensor Omega_(Y^c). Include r=0. This is a diagnostic class, not asserted to be generated by O1.
definitions.source_sector: For u_Lambda form S_vac=|u_Lambda><Omega_Lambda|-adjoint and A_vac=|v_Lambda><Omega_Lambda|+adjoint. Determine precisely the canceled operator. Compare it with the R1 local A_Y tensor I and record the remaining excited-exterior operator. Do not silently replace identity by the exterior vacuum projection.
definitions.specified_series_to_test: Test the form-sandwiched Neumann representation with K=H0^(-1/2)D H0^(-1/2) on Q, if its bounded extension and infinite form exist, and terms u_n=H0^(-1/2)(-K)^n H0^(-1/2)v. The displayed equation is a proposed proof route, not an admitted identity. Derive all bounds and domain/locality premises; a different valid proof may supplement it.
definitions.weight_test: For the specified collar-indexed representation, retain declared support Y^(n) and assess the upper certificate sum_n exp(mu |Y^(n)|) b_n, where mu>0 and b_n is the proved geometric uniform norm majorant for u_n (or the associated local rank-two coefficient). Evaluate the origin singleton and fixed nonzero tau. Distinguish failure of this particular upper certificate from divergence of actual norms, impossibility of every regrouping or an all-stage no-go theorem. Relate carefully to O2 fixed positive volume-weight requirements.

graph_boundary: Retain precisely stars b+G wholly contained in Lambda, G={0,e_x,e_y,e_z}; all21 omitted anchored faces in each retained phi_b. Generated Y is a finite nonempty connected union of complete onsite factors.
model: Exactly the homogeneous full-link O1/I1 selected-strip/free reference, not Q finite electric/magnetic projection or the canonical summable q profile.
next_loop: There is no further executed loop. After the tenth loop, conduct the complete skeptical claim/dependency audit, choose exactly three future goals, update demonstrated skill lessons and complete authorized reviewed publication.
proposed_not_accepted: A boundary-complete inverse may have summable spatial response tails at the actual small coupling. Neither useful operator homological cancellation nor the O2 volume-weight interaction norm follows from a uniform inverse norm alone.
representation: The same complete-factor product-reference incomplete tensor product over the positive coarse octant, with finite-volume embeddings by the exterior vacuum. Construct any infinite initial-diagonal operator by a proved closed form on this fixed representation. This is not an interacting-ground representation or a Gauss/continuum transfer.
